name: Notice
summary: A message with a tone — the icon decorates, the word carries it. The live role goes on the container the notice lands in, never on the notice, and role="alert" is for errors only. Four live failures: the notice with no prefix word, the role that rides in on the message, the alert that fires on every page load, and the close button that drops focus to the top of the document.
demoNote: Examples 2 to 5 are live. Example 2's notices announce one identical sentence in two tones; example 3 adds the same notice three ways and logs which one a screen reader was given; example 4's alert fired before you arrived, and again on every reload; example 5's close button leaves focus on the document body.

contract.useWhen: An inline message: the word carries the tone, the icon carries nothing.
keyboard: the dismiss button — whose handler owes focus somewhere afterwards
failureModes: role=status on the notice rather than on the container, which was never being watched
role=alert present at page load, interrupting on every render
color as the only cue for the tone (SC 1.4.1)
two buttons both named Close, naming nothing
the focused dismiss button removed with no answer for where focus goes
